scripts.desktop:package:mac: npm run prepare:mac-icon && npm run build && electron-forge package --platform=darwin --arch=x64

scripts.desktop:package:windows: npm run prepare:windows-icon && npm run build && electron-forge package --platform=win32 --arch=x64
